solution.title: Troubleshooting Microsoft Entra Connect Cloud Sync — Users Skipped / Not Provisioned to Entra (JoinNotFound, Scoping, Config & Quarantine)

products.name: Troubleshooting Microsoft Entra Connect Cloud Sync — Users Skipped / Not Provisioned to Entra (JoinNotFound, Scoping, Config & Quarantine) — Commercial
products.short_description: A structured diagnostic workflow and read-only tools for when Microsoft Entra Connect cloud sync is configured but creates no accounts — provision on demand shows Import / In scope / Match, then "User was skipped, JoinNotFound." Find the real reason and get to action = Create. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Your cloud sync says JoinNotFound and won't create users — here's why

You set up Microsoft Entra Connect cloud sync to synchronize on-premises Active Directory users into Microsoft Entra ID. It looks configured, the agent looks healthy — but no accounts are created. Run provision on demand and you see Import ✓ / In scope ✓ / Match ✓, then Evaluate action → "User was skipped" with SkipReason: JoinNotFound. Nothing is broken on the network — one specific condition is stopping the create, and cloud sync's own logs will tell you which. This diagnostics toolkit gives you a structured, read-only workflow and five PowerShell tools that snapshot the agent, read the authoritative per-object reason, and classify the object — so the fix is named in minutes instead of guessed at over days.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run, read-only PowerShell.

  • Simpler — the authoritative skip reason read for you from the provisioning logs, and every condition classified, so you name the cause instead of guessing.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every incident.
  • Tested — a diagnostic workflow (Collect → Analyze → Remediate → Verify) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how cloud sync differs from the older Entra Connect Sync, what JoinNotFound actually means (the evaluate step found no target to join and no new object to create), and the conditions that cause it: an already-existing target from a prior sync method, an out-of-scope OU, a disabled configuration, a quarantined job, a deletion threshold, a missing service principal, or an unhealthy agent.
  • Requirements Guide — the agent-host, Active Directory, Entra, and Microsoft Graph read access to diagnose, each with how to verify it.
  • Diagnostic Workflow — the ordered Collect → Analyze → Remediate → Verify process and a symptom → tool map that sends you straight to the right check.
  • 5 PowerShell diagnostic tools — an agent-host collector, an agent-health check, a provisioning-log reader (the authoritative skip reason by ObjectGuid/UPN), a sync-job/quarantine/SP check, and an Active Directory object test. All read-only.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides — gates that prove the tools read a known-good object as provisioning and the known-bad object's true skip reason, plus a comprehensive symptom → cause → fix matrix for "users skipped / JoinNotFound / not provisioned."

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each incident feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next outage and the next project.

The bottom line

The reason cloud sync is skipping users — JoinNotFound and the condition behind it — isolated in minutes with read-only tools you keep and reuse on every incident, so provision on demand creates the user and the provisioning log shows action = Create.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click toolkit: solution overview, requirements, the diagnostic workflow, testing, the symptom → cause → fix matrix, and best practices.
  • PowerShell Diagnostic Tools (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run, read-only tools (nothing is modified on the host, tenant, configuration, or object):
    • CLDSYNCDX-Collect-Diagnostics.ps1 — on-host master collector (agent services, Trace folder, AADCloudSyncTools export)
    • CLDSYNCDX-Check-Agent.ps1 — provisioning-agent health check (services, execution policy, outbound 443, proxy)
    • CLDSYNCDX-Get-ProvisioningLog.ps1 — read the authoritative provisioning-log reason (action / status / skipReason) by ObjectGuid or UPN
    • CLDSYNCDX-Check-Provisioning.ps1 — sync-job Active/Enabled/Quarantined, sync-service SP presence, onPremisesSyncEnabled
    • CLDSYNCDX-Test-Object.ps1 — AD object test: critical-object, in-scope OU, UPN routability, duplicate advisory

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
